items.title: Mets Owner Steve Cohen’s Fund Dumped Nearly All of Its AMD and Bet $1 Billion That Microsoft Is the Safer AI Stock. AMD Has Fallen 31% Since
items.summary: Steve Cohen's Point72 sold 99% of its AMD shares in the third quarter and raised its Microsoft stake from 31,522 shares to 2,055,578, about $1 billion of buying, its Nov. 16 13F shows. AMD has fallen 31% since Sept. 30 and Microsoft 6%. The same filing tripled Intel, which has since lost more than half its value.
